bhop.settings.title: BHOP Settings
bhop.settings.heading: BHOP
bhop.settings.general.bhop_mode.tooltip: Bunny hop movement with air strafing. Same as the toggle key.
bhop.settings.general.set_by_server: Set by the server you're playing on.
bhop.settings.general.auto_hop.tooltip: Hold jump to chain hops. Turn off to time every landing by hand.
bhop.settings.general.jump_buffer.toolti: A jump pressed up to this many ticks before landing still hops on the landing tick. 0 means exact timing.
bhop.settings.general.scroll_jump.toolti: Jump with the mouse wheel while bunny hop mode is on, as shooter players often bind it. The wheel stops changing hotbar slots until the mode is off.
bhop.settings.general.speed_cap.tooltip: Top horizontal speed reachable by strafing, in blocks per second.
bhop.settings.general.ramp_up.tooltip: Strafing gains speed faster until you reach the ramp-up speed, then returns to the normal rate.
bhop.settings.general.ramp_up_multiplier: How much faster strafing gains speed during ramp-up. 1.0x is no boost.
bhop.settings.general.ramp_up_speed.tool: The speed at which the ramp-up boost stops, in blocks per second.
bhop.settings.hud.show_speed.tooltip: Show your horizontal speed above the hotbar while bunny hop mode is on.
bhop.settings.hud.show_gain.tooltip: Under the speedometer: speed gained (green) or lost (red) on your last hop, in blocks per second.
bhop.settings.hud.show_hop_timing.toolti: Under the speedometer: Perfect when you jumped on the landing tick with no friction, or how many ticks late you were.
bhop.settings.hud.show_sync.tooltip: Under the speedometer: how much of your mouse turning in the air matched the strafe key held.
bhop.settings.hud.announce_toggle.toolti: Show a short message when bunny hop mode is switched on or off.
